name: SaaS SE Efficiency 2025
description: Peer benchmarks for SaaS sales engineering and value-engineering workflow efficiency. Curated from mid-market B2B SaaS participants in North America.
data_source: Value Fabric SE Benchmark Study 2025 / OpenView Partners

se_hours_per_opportunity.name: se_hours_per_opportunity
se_hours_per_opportunity.description: Sales engineering hours spent per qualified opportunity across the full sales cycle (discovery through close).

sales_cycle_days.name: sales_cycle_days
sales_cycle_days.description: Average length of a qualified opportunity sales cycle for mid-market SaaS deals.

late_stage_win_rate_percent.name: late_stage_win_rate_percent
late_stage_win_rate_percent.description: Win rate for opportunities that reach late-stage evaluation (proposal/negotiation).

ae_se_ratio.name: ae_se_ratio
ae_se_ratio.description: Ratio of account executives to sales engineers in the GTM organization.
